description: Look up a job family by its slug and get its focus areas (specializations) with their titles, plus untagged titles. Use this to discover the focus tags and titles available within a role (e.g. to find focusTagSlugs for the benchmark tools). Use search-job-families first if you only have a name. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

name: get-job-family
